top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation by heterobifunctional degraders (Crews, Deshaies, Ciulli) turned regulated proteolysis into a designable, quantitatively measurable chemical reaction (ternary-complex formation, cooperativity, linker geometry) that has been reproduced across many ligases, targets and laboratories. A citation limited to heterobifunctional degraders matches what the three laureates can be credited for. The omission of Sakamoto and the cereblon glue strand, and the lack of an approved PROTAC, are real costs but concern the edges of the citation, not the established mechanism. Liu-only base editing (P002) is my close second for its clean attribution; nitrogenase structure and a Liu-plus-nitrogenase pairing follow, then phase separation, whose condensate-as-phase claims I consider less settled. No award is last.
